args.title: Issue 4405: change src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component in src/components/ExportButton.tsx always initializes its format state to defaultFormat (defaulting to 'csv'), and does not remember the last selected export format between openings. Changing this to persist the last chosen format in the browser local storage or similar would implement the requested feature to remember the export format.
